name: Grafana Cloud API
tagline: Programmatic access to Grafana Cloud stacks, org settings, and observability resources.
description: Grafana Cloud provides HTTP APIs for managing Cloud organizations, stacks, access policies, and related resources, plus product APIs for metrics, logs, and dashboards. Developers use service accounts, access policies, and tokens to automate provisioning and operations against their Grafana Cloud instance.

auth.details: Cloud API uses bearer tokens from access policies or service account tokens; product APIs use instance-specific credentials. Exact header and token type vary by endpoint family.

use_cases: list Grafana Cloud stacks for an organization
create or rotate Cloud access policy tokens
provision service accounts for automated agents
query Cloud org membership and billing-related metadata
